rules.coverage: High: <=10% null on applicable rows and values in 5 seasons; Medium: <=30% and 5 seasons; Low: >30% or fewer than 5 seasons
rules.association: |pooled Spearman| >= 0.5 strong, >= 0.3 moderate, >= 0.1 weak, else none (Phase 4.3)
rules.beyond_playing_time: |partial Spearman given starts| >= 0.25 retained, 0.10-0.25 partly retained, < 0.10 mostly playing time
rules.redundancy: max |Spearman| with another outfield feature >= 0.9 high, >= 0.8 medium, else low (outfield matrix, Phase 4.3)
rules.position: GK only, or outfield within-position Spearman range >= 0.25: position-specific; else general
rules.identity: |change in Spearman without P4-B01| >= 0.05 sensitive, else robust
rules.tail: values beyond 3 IQR > 2% of observed values: heavy tail; else moderate/none
rules.interpretability: judgment: {"age (years)": "high", "season count/total": "high", "per-90 rate": "medium", "percentage (source-reported)": "medium", "season total (model-based)": "medium", "average rating (0-10)": "low (composite source score)"}
rules.usefulness: judgment by explicit rules in feasibility.usefulness()
